meta.statistic: median of the clean runs per route with min and max (the busy runs when a route has no clean run); linear interpolation between the closest ranks (type 7, the NumPy and Excel default)
meta.inp: null: Lighthouse navigation mode does not compute INP. Lab INP comes from the perf agent's traces.
meta.lcpPhases: observedPhasesMs come from lcp-breakdown-insight and describe the unthrottled observed load, so they do not sum to the simulated LCP in metrics.lcpMs. metrics.observedLcpMs is the matching observed value.
meta.runSelection: one record per run number: the latest clean run (load 6 or less at the start and after, and benchmarkIndex at least minBenchmarkIndex), else the busy run with the lowest load (the latest of equals), which is then counted in runsOnBusyMachine. The medians, minima and maxima use the clean runs only, and the busy runs only for a route that has none (statsBasis, statsRuns); allRunsSpread has the numbers over every run. Other attempts are listed in supersededRuns.
